notes.title: Bug Fixes for Funk Unplugged!
notes.content:
Hello Funky Fans! 

After a small hiatus we received a note that there were some really glaring issues introduced into Funk Unplugged with the SoundScape DLC! 

A community member Andet messaged me directly on Twitter and because of his diligence we went in and fixed the issues that have been plaguing the game! 

Bug Fixes:

NPCs on Treble Tropics track 3, should no longer trap Ampy in a conversation with them.

The hidden door on Treble Tropics track 2 should no longer get stuck in the door reveal cinematic. 

Corrected an issue where Ampy was not able to keep the glide ability after completing New Tempo City Track 1

Corrected an issue where Ampy was not able to look at the move master pedestals after beating New Tempo City Track 1

Fixed an error that prevented achievements from firing.

That was all of the major issues we were notified about by our wonderful community! I am going to keep monitoring the steam forums and Vamped Games support email for further issues! 

Have fun and stay funky! 

Vamped Games

notes.title: Funk Unplugged Soundscape Update now available!
notes.content:

This update was only possible because you, so thank you for your support!

The Vamped Games Team

notes.title: Funk Unplugged - Quick Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we anticipated, our engine upgrade still had a few bugs to work out! We've pushed out a few fixes to alleviate these issues. Check out the fixes below!

- Sprint Jump fixed, no longer causing a loss of momentum
- Fixed an issue where the sensitivity setting was not properly being saved
- Fixed an issue where Phantom Records would not spin or be collected
- Fixed the lava in Beathoven's Castle Track 3.

Stay Funky!

notes.title: Funk Unplugged - August Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Long time no see!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27891888/01a46f5e5675db077912493f6bce248efb7d40cb.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27891888/ddf1a11f4ff2989358d51bc6fe6fabecac67b018.png[/img][/url]

Pardon our dust; we know it's been a while since you've seen anything from us. Rest assured, we are still working on the game! Tonight, we are pushing out an update to the game that, while not huge for you, is quite an update on our end. We upgraded our game engine, Unity, up a few versions. This took a bit longer than expected, but now that it is complete, we are resuming normal work!

In upgrading our game up so many versions, there may be bugs we didn't catch, despite our best efforts. If you notice any, please let us know!

We still have some more surprises in store, including our upcoming free DLC, so be sure to check back! 

Big Changes:

- Upgraded water tech
- Fixed Jump Exploits
- Attempted Performance Fixes
- Fixed World 2 Boss Glitches

Thanks for still being Funky!

- The Funk Unplugged Team

notes.title: Funk Unplugged - Update 6/25
notes.content:
Hello funky fans!

We're pushing out a quick update for you all this evening, the main feature being adding sensitivity controls to the Options menu, as well as speeding up the controller's looking speed. An eagle-eyed fan spotted a wall that you could just walk though... whoops! We fixed that as well.

We are aware of some other issues that we will address in the future, such as audio sync issues, but we wanted to get this out to you as soon as we could.

Have fun, thanks for playing, and stay funky!

notes.title: Funk Unplugged Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello Funky Fans!

We're happy to announce a feature that many have requested has finally been implemented: achievements! On top of that, we've made a few other tweaks, so read on below!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27891888/d321333fa12e1126a2214ecbcde0b6853cfa3dc5.png[/img]

6/3 Changelog:
- Achievements implemented. For ones that should already be earned, they may not fire right away, but if you play a level, they should activate.
- Level portals now show your collected Jolts and Golden Records.
- Players no longer have to stop sprinting to start attacking.
- Fixed some issues with Beathoven's Castle Track 2 that prevented all collectibles from being obtained.
- Fixed issue where players could collect more Jolts in a level than intended.
- Various small bug fixes.

notes.title: Funk Unplugged - Quick Patch
notes.content:
Hello Funky Fans!

We realized there was a small glitch with a Golden Record in Beatoven's Castle Track 3 that made collecting it impossible. We apologize for this mistake! This update makes it collectible! Be sure you give the outside courtyard area another look!

Be on the lookout for another update soon!

Vamped Games Team

notes.title: Patch notes for 5/29!
notes.content:
Hello Funky Fans!

In an attempt to stay funky-fresh, we are pushing out another update that will go live later today! A big point of feedback so far has been the sprinting double-jump. In an attempt to maintain game balance while also listening to fan feedback, we have pushed an update to this jump, but it will be subject to change based on reaction & additional testing. Read up on the changes below:

- Edited sprinting double-jump. The original sprint jump now goes slightly less high, and the sprint double-jump goes less high, but maintains momentum from the first jump.
- Fixed an issue with the player collecting too many Jolts in Arctic Aria Track 1.
- Attempt at fix for mines not disappearing upon player death in New Tempo City Track 3.
- Fixed an issue where the skins/hats menus would lock up with a controller. 
- Fixed an issue where the Jolt-Reward NPCs wouldn't activate the reward properly. 
- Fixed an issue where the Desert Camo skin would unlock the Grey Camo skin.

notes.title: Patch notes for 5/26!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have just released the first update for Funk Unplugged! Some issues may still be present, but we wanted to fix up ones causing bigger issues. You can read about them below. Stay Funky!

 
Funk Unplugged Update - 5/26
There seems to be a rare case of the customization menus locking up at times. To alleviate this while we investigate, pushing either escape, enter, or start on the Xbox Gamepad should close any menu
Updated controller menu to show crouch controls for xbox
Treble Tropics Track 2 - attempted fix at shaking water
Arctic Aria Track 3 - attempted fix for platforms that player could not properly land on over water section
Arctic Aria Boss - attempted fix where boss’ arm would not properly return to boss 
New Tempo City Track 3 - Fixed invisible wall colliders
Known errors
Some saw spedora enemies may not damage the player on impact
Players may need to talk to jolt-reward bots twice for their reward to activate
